title: Roma youth's chances and the inequality of the school system
title_hu: A roma fiatalok esélyei és az iskolarendszer egyenlőtlensége
summary_en: What chances do Roma youth have in Hungary's school system? Kertesi's KRTK monograph synthesises decades of research on Roma educational outcomes in Hungary — the share of Roma children completing each schooling stage, segregated-class outcomes, dropout patterns, and the wage and employment consequences of the system's failures. The book quantifies the cost of school-system inequality for Roma children and identifies the institutional levers (early-childhood programmes, desegregation policies, mentoring) that have measurable effects.
policy_relevance: Foundational reference for Hungarian Roma-integration policy (BM Roma Stratégia, EMMI, EU Roma Framework national action plans): provides the most comprehensive empirical baseline on Roma educational disadvantage and the strongest evidence on which interventions work. Standard input for Hungarian Roma-strategy programming and for EU-funded Roma-integration project design.
